title: Highway realignment crossing 17 archaeological sites
summary: On July 2, the commission deferred its review of the archaeological inventory survey plan for a highway realignment to August 6th without a vote, because too few eligible members could act. The planned route crosses 17 known archaeological sites.

timeline.text: Review and comment on the archaeological inventory survey plan for a highway realignment project: The highway survey plan item was deferred to August 6th without a vote because too few members could act.
The highway presentation will be linked on the agenda.
The planned highway route crosses 17 known archaeological sites.
With too few eligible voters, the commission could not comment on an archaeological survey plan for a highway realignment.

fromCommunityMeetings.quote: So there's discussion of some monies we've received from the federal government and from other sources, other partners, to try to realign that road so we can improve access in and out of Lahaina.
fromCommunityMeetings.about: Says federal and partner money is being pursued to realign Honoapiʻilani Highway between Ukumehame and Olowalu to improve Lahaina access.
